captureFullPolicyholderDetailsNominee: Capture full policyholder details, nominee information, and both current and previous policy terms in one place — then search, sort, and update them as circumstances change. Works for life, health, motor, and all insurance policies alike.
automaticallySurfacesPoliciesWithPayment: Automatically surfaces policies with payments due this month, coming up next, or missed, so follow-ups happen before a policy lapses — whatever kind of policy it is. Reminders reach you through the in-app bell, phone or desktop push notifications, and email, and you choose which ones to receive. Update a payment date in a couple of taps, or call, WhatsApp, SMS, or email the policyholder straight from the list.
aBuiltInReferralWallet: A built-in referral wallet tracks direct and second-level referrals, and your wallet balance can be used toward plan renewals and upgrades.
adminsGetDedicatedTools: Admins get dedicated tools to manage user accounts, handle support requests, and keep the platform running smoothly — without touching agents' day-to-day workspace.
lifeTermLifeHealthFamily: Life, term life, health, family health, vehicle, and travel policies each come with the fields that matter for that product — and an Other (Custom) type lets you name a policy type and design your own fields when none of them fit.
movingFromSpreadsheetsImport: Moving from spreadsheets? Import an Excel or CSV file with a preview that highlights every cell to fix before saving. When you need a copy, export your records — with any search or type filter applied — to PDF or CSV.
everyRecordListPoliciesDue: Every record list — policies, due payments, and users — supports instant search and column sorting, so finding one record among thousands takes seconds.
fullEnglishAndHindiLanguage: Full English and Hindi language support, Indian date formats, and terminology tailored to the way insurance policies are discussed, understood, and handled in real-world field operations across India.
learnWhoBuildsPolicyNiketan: Learn who builds Policy Niketan, why we built a dedicated record-keeping tool for all types of insurance agents, and how we keep client data secure.

notBuiltForOneInsurance: Not built for one insurance line. Built for all of them.
thisPlatformWasNeverDesigned: This platform was never designed around a single insurance category. everythingToRunPolicyOperations: Everything to run policy operations, day to day

yourDataIsTooSafe: Your data is too safe to worry about.
policyAndPolicyholderData: Policy and policyholder data is sensitive, and we treat it that way. Security isn't an afterthought here — it's built into how the platform stores, backs up, and protects every record you enter, day after day.
yourRecordsAreBackedUp: Your records are backed up day by day, without exception. If anything ever goes wrong on our end, your data can be restored quickly — nothing is ever left resting on a single copy.
everyAccountIsAuthenticatedBefore: Every account is authenticated before it can see a single record. Sensitive fields like Aadhaar, PAN, and bank details are encrypted before they are stored, and are only ever visible to the agent who owns them, or an admin acting within their role. A Hide button masks them on screen whenever you need privacy. You can also review your own activity log and sign out any active session yourself, any time.
everyQueryClosedOutUsually: Every query closed out — usually the same day.
weDonTLetQueries: We don't let queries pile up. The goal is a clean queue at the end of every day — no agent waiting overnight for an answer that could've come sooner.
questionsAndIssuesAreTypically: Questions and issues are typically closed out within a few hours of being raised — not days.
noAgentGoesToSleep: No agent goes to sleep waiting on an answer. Every query gets handled the same day it comes in.
supportIsnTOutsourced: Support isn't outsourced to a generic helpdesk — the team answering understands policy workflows.
builtAndSupported: Built and supported with the reliability agents need to run their business on, every single day.

joinAgentsAlreadyManagingEvery: Join agents already managing every policy type, safely, in one place.
preferToTalkRequest: Prefer to talk? <link>Request a call</link> and our team will phone you during business hours.
availableAroundTheClock: Available around the clock for critical account or data issues.
